questions.q: Why did Silver thank Jim at the start of the chapter?
choices: Jim had refused to run away when the doctor urged him
Jim had told him where the treasure was
Jim had bandaged his leg
Jim had cooked his breakfast
questions.evidence: I seen you say no, as plain as hearing

questions.q: What did the pirates' wasteful breakfast show Jim about them?
choices: They were unfit for a long campaign
They had plenty of food stored away
They were excellent cooks
They were planning a feast for Silver
questions.evidence: I could see their entire unfitness for anything like a prolonged campaign

questions.q: What did one pirate do with the leftover food?
choices: Threw it into the fire
Saved it for supper
Gave it to the parrot
Buried it in the sand
questions.evidence: threw what was left into the fire

questions.q: What did Silver tell his crew he planned to do once they found the treasure?
choices: Find the ship and take it, since they had the boats
Share the treasure with the doctor
Bury it again somewhere safer
Sail home in the gigs
questions.evidence: us that has the boats, I reckon, has the upper hand

questions.q: Why was Jim "horribly cast down" after hearing Silver's plan?
choices: He believed Silver would betray him if the pirates' scheme could work
He was sick from the bacon
He had lost his pistols
He missed his mother
questions.evidence: Silver, already doubly a traitor, would not hesitate to adopt it

questions.q: Which of the doctor's words still puzzled and worried Jim?
choices: Look out for squalls when you find it
Keep the boy close beside you
Duty first and pleasure afterwards
Camp in a bog, would you?
questions.evidence: "Look out for squalls when you find it,"

questions.q: Jim says he "was led like a dancing bear." What does he mean?
choices: He was tied by a rope and led along by Silver
He danced to cheer up the pirates
He walked slowly and heavily
He growled at the pirates
questions.evidence: I was led like a dancing bear

questions.q: Where did the pirates' food and stores come from?
choices: From Jim's friends' supplies
From hunting goats on the island
From Ben Gunn's cave
From the wrecked ship
questions.evidence: All the stores, I observed, came from our stock

questions.q: According to the note on the chart, what was the main landmark?
choices: A tall tree
A big rock
A cave
A spring of water
questions.evidence: A tall tree was thus the principal mark

questions.q: Why was it hard to tell which tree was Flint's "tall tree"?
choices: Several pines rose far above their neighbours on the plateau
All the trees had been cut down
The chart showed no trees at all
It was too dark to see the trees
questions.evidence: Every here and there, one of a different species rose forty or fifty feet clear above its neighbours

questions.q: How did Jim help Silver as they climbed the hill?
choices: He lent him a hand so he would not fall
He carried Silver's guns
He held the parrot
He read the compass for him
questions.evidence: I had to lend him a hand

questions.q: What did the pirate on the far left find that made him cry out?
choices: A human skeleton under a pine
The treasure chest
A live snake
Ben Gunn's boat
questions.evidence: a human skeleton lay, with a few shreds of clothing

questions.q: What was strange about the way the skeleton lay?
choices: It was perfectly straight with its hands pointing above its head
It was curled up in a ball
It was sitting against the tree
It had no head
questions.evidence: his hands, raised above his head like a diver's

questions.q: What did Silver figure out about the skeleton?
choices: Flint had laid it down as a pointer toward the treasure
It was a sailor who died of fever
It belonged to Ben Gunn
It was a warning to leave the island

questions.q: Whose bones did Silver think the skeleton was?
choices: Allardyce
Billy Bones
Captain Flint
Black Dog

questions.q: How did the pirates behave after finding the skeleton?
choices: They kept side by side and spoke quietly in fear
They ran ahead shouting and leaping
They turned back to the boats
They began fighting each other
questions.evidence: The terror of the dead buccaneer had fallen on their spirits

questions.q: What is this chapter mostly about?
choices: The treasure hunt begins and the pirates find a skeleton Flint left as a pointer
The pirates find the treasure and divide it
Jim escapes from Silver in the woods
The doctor attacks the pirates' camp
questions.evidence: Right up there is our line for the Pole Star and the jolly dollars
